data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 2.6m (2013: GBP 0.7m) net of reinsurance were made from prior year reserves. The reserve release in 2014 was generated by the Fire and other damage to property and Reinsurance segments.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2013 balance) was GBP 64.958m. The Syndicate reports an aggregate net release from prior year reserves of GBP 2.6m in 2014 driven by favourable development in the Fire and other damage to property and Reinsurance segments. No gross prior year movement figure is provided in the notes, so the reported net release has been used.
raw_causal_phrases: Losses continue to develop, both positively and negatively on these open balances.

Opening reserves were taken as the closing gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2013 (GBP 64,958k). Energy - Marine premium is very small (3k).
